newsitem.title: USA: Signal Technology sees weak Q2 results.
newsitem.headline: Signal Technology sees weak Q2 results.

text.p: Signal Technology Corp warned Wednesday that revenues and earnings for its second fiscal quarter will be below expectations.
A company spokesman said earnings per share and revenues will fall below previous expectations of $0.08 a share and $30.6 million.
"We expect sales and margins for the second quarter of 1997 to be lower than those reported for the first quarter of this year," said Chairman and Chief Executive Dale Peterson.
In the first quarter, Signal earned $0.10 a share on revenues of $27 million. In the year-ago second quarter the company earned $0.02 a share on revenues of $27.3 million.
"This situation was caused by difficulties encountered on several contracts as they end their development phase," Peterson said.
"However, our backlog remains strong and we expect solid performance in the third and fourth quarters."
